readme.run: Detect both carotids and write their flow curves
notes: Give one series holding the amplitude frames followed by the phase frames,
or the amplitude and phase series as two files, amplitude first.
Raw phase stored as +-4096 needs --venc. Add --help for every setting.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with
dcm2niix first, or use the web app. Label editing needs the web app.
Carotid Flow is research software. Review the detected vessels before use.
The example reference is PCMCalculator: Vestergaard MB. PCMCalculator
